Enzo 💬 (On if Marc Guéhi will play in midfield against Palace) We will see. He is an option. The good thing about Marc is that he gives us one more option in the middle if we need. We have a session in a few hours and then we will decide.

Enzo 💬 Palace away is always complicated. It’s a complicated pitch, a good team, and a new manager has arrived. You can see from pre-season and the first game what they want to do - it’s quite clear. It’s similar to Oliver [Glasner], their former manager. No doubt it will be a tough game.
Enzo 💬 Yeah, Elliot [Anderson] is fully fit. Last week was just cramp.
